title: From Shared Demand Patterns to Local Uncertainty: Probabilistic Load Forecasting by Mixing Compact Adaptations (abstract page)
note: arXiv v1, 6 Oct 2026, Li, Cheng, Weng; cs.LG; text licence CC BY 4.0. Abstract: a shared model plus a small bank of low-dimensional adaptations mixed per load; on 590 SMART-DS load profiles it reports better deterministic and probabilistic scores than statistical, neural, Transformer and pretrained baselines at low storage and inference cost. No numbers in the abstract.

title: Compact adaptations paper, full text: setup
note: Setup: SMART-DS synthetic distribution data (San Francisco, Greensboro, Austin), 590 residential/commercial/industrial profiles, year 2018, 15-min aggregated to hourly. 24 h ahead issued daily at midnight from 168 h of load history. Train Jan-Oct, validate Nov, test Dec 1-30 2018 (30 origins per profile). Weather is named as an optional input in the formulation; experiments name only load history.

title: haorandd/M2oE2_load_forecast (repository named in the paper)
note: Public repo, MIT licence, 91 commits, 4 stars. README describes the M2oE2 variational mixture-of-experts forecaster with load, temperature, workday and season inputs on other datasets (solar, residential, building, Spanish, GEFCom2014); data is linked on Zenodo and Hugging Face, not included. Run by a training script; no description of SMART-DS or mLoRA on the front page.

title: haorandd/M2oE2_load_forecast: code directory listing
note: Listing shows M2oE2 training scripts, baseline scripts (ARIMA, LSTM, CNN-GRU, iTransformer, Informer), a LoRA utility file, a GEFCom2014 folder and one GEFCom2014 checkpoint. No file or folder named for mLoRA or SMART-DS, and no checkpoint for the paper's 590-profile model. Listing may be truncated; file contents were not read.

title: haorandd/M2oE2_load_forecast: commit history
note: Latest commit 24 Sep 2026 (file upload and README update), twelve days before the arXiv posting; earlier visible commits are from late May and 1 June 2026. No visible commit message mentions mLoRA, LoRA or SMART-DS.

title: Search: M2oE2 mLoRA SMART-DS Mixing Compact Adaptations replication or code (no replication found)
note: One web search for an independent rerun found none. It returned the paper itself, the authors' earlier M2oE2 and M2oE2-GL papers and their Zenodo data record, which point to the same repository, and an unrelated SMART-DS transformer benchmark repo; none of those extra pages were opened or used.

title: Compact adaptations paper, full text: model and baselines
note: Model: M2oE2, a variational GRU sequence model trained from scratch (not pretrained); mLoRA adds LoRA adapters on the output heads, mixed by soft membership over 15 Gaussian-mixture clusters. Baselines: ARIMA+Fourier, GRU, LSTM, CNN-GRU, DeepAR, iTransformer, PatchTST, Chronos-2 and TimesFM-2.5 zero-shot, TimesFM-2.5+LoRA, plain M2oE2. No pre-registration, seeds or intervals.

title: Compact adaptations paper, full text: Table II results
note: Table II, Dec 2018 test. M2oE2-mLoRA: range-normalised MSE 2.72e-3, MAE 1.60 kW, CRPS 1.18; 0.11 ms per forecast, 0.58 MiB. Plain M2oE2: MSE 2.98e-3, MAE 1.79, CRPS 1.32. TimesFM-2.5+LoRA MSE 3.15e-3. Chronos-2 zero-shot MSE 3.21e-3, MAE 2.02, CRPS 1.48. TimesFM-2.5 zero-shot MSE 3.74e-3. Text: MSE 8.72% below M2oE2 and 13.65% below TimesFM-2.5+LoRA.
